5 تكوّر He fell upon his side, and drew himself together; syn. تَقَطَّرَ وَتَشَمَّرَ: (S, K:) or he wrapped himself up, and tucked up his garment, or skirt, or the like; syn. تَلَفَّفَ وَتَشَمَّرَ. (TA.) ―
-b2- He fell; fell down. (S, K.) ―
-b3- He became prostrated; as also ↓ إِكْتَارَ : (K:) or اكتار signifies he prostrated a thing, one part upon another. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
